guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile build failed during the installation of Python 3.11 related packages on Ubuntu 20.04. The error messages are: "E: Unable to locate package python3.11", "E: Unable to locate package python3.11-venv", and "E: Unable to locate package python3.11-distutils". This indicates that Python 3.11 packages are not available in the default Ubuntu 20.04 repositories. To fix this, update the Dockerfile to either:

1. Use the official deadsnakes PPA for Python 3.11 by adding:
   RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y software-properties-common && add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa && apt-get update
before installing Python 3.11 packages.

2. Or change the Python version to 3.10 (which is available by default on Ubuntu 20.04) by adjusting all python3.11 references accordingly.

Additionally, ensure the installation commands install python3.11-venv and python3.11-distutils correctly from the PPA.

Without fixing these environment setup issues, the container build cannot proceed and tests cannot run.
